WORK AROUND THE WORLD · three jobs this summer

No pay. Free food and a bed. You work about five hours a day and the rest of the day is yours.

JOB 1 · A SMALL HOTEL BY A LAKE, FINLAND. You help in the kitchen in the morning and clean four rooms. The hotel is in the woods, twenty minutes from the nearest village, and there is a boat you can use. Good for a quiet person who likes water and doesn't mind getting up early. June to August. Six people needed.

JOB 2 · A CHILDREN'S CAMP NEAR THE COAST, PORTUGAL. You look after children between six and eleven years old — games in the morning, the beach in the afternoon. You don't need Portuguese. You do need patience. The camp is ten minutes from a long beach and the scenery is beautiful. July only. Twelve people needed.

JOB 3 · A MOUNTAIN FARM, GEORGIA. You work with animals and repair fences. It is hard physical work and it is cold in the evenings, even in summer. But you live with a local family, you eat what they eat, and in three months your Georgian will be better than your English. May to September. Two people needed.

2

Grammar · be going to

TUSHUNTIRISH — BE GOING TO

BE GOING TO — oldindan qilingan reja uchun. Bu shunchaki fikr yoki orzu emas, gapirishdan oldin qabul qilingan qaror.

+ be + going to + feʼl. I'm going to find out more about it. · She's going to leave her job. · We're going to stay in a hotel.

− Inkor qilish uchun feʼlni emas, BE ni inkor qiling. I'm not going to go to university next year. · They aren't going to visit us.

? Savolda BE oldinga chiqadi. You are going to do it. → Are you going to do it? · What are you going to do? · Is he going to come?

! Har doim uch qism: be + going to + feʼlning oddiy shakli. Oʻquvchilar koʻpincha bittasini — odatda oʻrtadagisini — tushirib qoldiradi.

Urgʻu qayerga tushadi. going to ga emas — asosiy feʼlga. What are you going to DO? · I'm going to TRAVel. Tez nutqda going to deyarli eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun uni eshitmaysiz.

Toʻliq shakl

Qisqa shakl

+

I am going to travel.

I'm going to travel.

−

I am not going to travel.

I'm not going to travel.

?

Are you going to travel?

(savolda qisqa shakl yoʻq)

✓ ✗

Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

Yes, I'm deyilmaydi.

DIQQAT — KOʻP UCHRAYDIGAN XATOLAR

1 GOING ni tushirib qoldirmang. ✗ How are you to get to the airport? → ✓ How are you going to get to the airport?

2 AM / IS / ARE ni tushirib qoldirmang. ✗ We going to go to the beach. → ✓ We are going to go to the beach.

3 TO dan keyingi feʼlga -ing qoʻshilmaydi. ✗ I'm going to wearing my new shorts. → ✓ I'm going to wear my new shorts. Bir gapda bitta -ing yetarli.

4 GO TO — bu BE GOING TO emas. ✗ I'm happy that I go to Finland. → ✓ I'm happy that I'm going to Finland.

5 WILL bilan bir xil emas. ✗ I bought new boots because I will go hiking. → ✓ …because I'm going to go hiking. Botinkani allaqachon sotib oldingiz — demak, reja oldindan bor edi. Bu be going to.

Everyday English · is breakfast included?

HAYRATNI BILDIRISH

Kimdir sizga yangilik aytsa, ingliz tilida shunchaki oh deyilmaydi. Kichkina savol bilan javob beriladi — shu savol suhbatdoshingizga uni tinglayotganingizni bildiradi.

OSON YOʻL Really? — har doim ishlaydi. Har qanday yangilikka shunday javob berish mumkin.

YAXSHIROQ Gapdagi yordamchi feʼlni takrorlang. I've won a competition. → Have you? · She's going to leave. → Is she? · They came yesterday. → Did they?

Qanday tuziladi. Suhbatdoshning gapidan yordamchi feʼlni oling (have, is, did, can) va I ni you ga almashtiring. Ikki soʻz — va siz darslikdagidek emas, tirik odamdek gapirasiz.

Ohangni koʻtaring. Oxirida ovoz ancha koʻtariladi. Bir tekis aytilgan Have you? zerikkandek eshitiladi — siz aytmoqchi boʻlgan narsaning aksi.

MEHMONXONAGA JOYLASHISH

Oltita ibora — qayerda tursangiz ham, har safar hammasini ishlatasiz.

I've got a reservation for a double room for two nights.

Is breakfast included? · Is there a car park? · Is there wi-fi in the room? · Is there a safe in the room? · What time is checkout?

Ehtiyot boʻling: Is breakfast included? — Is breakfast include? emas. -ed soʻzning bir qismi, garchi deyarli eshitilmasa ham.

5.2 Complete the conversation at the hotel.

Mehmonxonadagi suhbatni toʻldiring.

RECEPTION

GUEST Hello. I've (1) a reservation for a double room for two nights. RECEPTIONIST Of course. Here's your keycard — room 312, on the third floor.

GUEST Thank you. Is breakfast (2)? RECEPTIONIST Yes, it's from seven until ten in the dining room, just over there.

GUEST Great. And is (3) wi-fi in the room? RECEPTIONIST There is. The password is on the card. GUEST And what (4) is checkout? RECEPTIONIST Checkout is at eleven.

TURISTIK MAʼLUMOT SOʻRASH

Yana beshtasi — pastdagi qabulxona yoki burchakdagi turistik ofis uchun.

Can you help me? · Is there a city bus tour I can go on? · How much is it for a ticket? · Can I buy tickets here? · I'll have a ticket, please.

Eng foydalisi — oxirgisi. I'll have a ticket, please ingliz tilida “buni hozir sotib olaman” degani. I want a ticket xato emas, lekin shirinlik soʻrayotgan boladek eshitiladi.

TALAFFUZ — T BILAN UNDOSHLAR GURUHI

Ingliz tilida soʻz oxirida bir nechta undosh ketma-ket keladi, /t/ esa koʻpincha ularning oʻrtasida boʻladi. Butun guruhni ayting — orasiga unli qoʻshmang.

next /nekst/ · tourist /tʊərɪst/ · left /left/ · tickets /tɪkɪts/ · nights /naɪts/

Qochish kerak boʻlgan xato: /neks-i-t/ yoki /lef-i-t/ demang — u yerda unli yoʻq. /t/ ni tez ayting, u deyarli eshitilmasin, lekin uni tashlab ham ketmang.

MODEL

ANNIE Good morning. Can you help me? Is there a city bus tour I can go on? RECEPTIONIST Yes, there is. It leaves from just outside the hotel.

ANNIE Great. And how much is it for a ticket? RECEPTIONIST It's fifteen pounds. ANNIE Can I buy a ticket here? RECEPTIONIST Yes, you can.

ANNIE And can I pay by card? RECEPTIONIST No problem. ANNIE OK. I'll have a ticket then, please.
